threads.body: [Testing] The new `ProducerSettings` match is not exercised by the installed-agent tests: `javaagent/build.gradle.kts:20` uses 5.0.2, while the 5.0.0 dependency is used only for unit tests. Neither those unit tests nor Muzzle checks verify that constructor advice captures the submission parent. Add a focused installed-agent regression test against 5.0.0 that submits under context A, executes deferred send work under context B, and asserts that the producer span remains a child of A. Retain coverage for the existing `PublishingSettings` path; a focused version-specific test avoids moving the full integration suite onto the older client versions noted as flaky in the build file.
